_how_to_add: Add only real reviews that a customer sent you (WhatsApp, Facebook, in person). Never write one yourself.
Copy one entry below and change it. 'product' must be the product slug from the URL, e.g. bigman-forza-protein-2kg.
rating: 1 to 5. text: the customer's own words. en: English translation if they wrote in Nepali (or leave empty).
image (optional): put the photo in source/reviews/ and write 'reviews/<file>.jpg'. Only with the customer's permission.
town and note are optional. The star rating and Google review schema appear automatically once a product has a review.
